scope: Fail-closed Core3 block, dodge, and counter resolution for authenticated Pre-CU rifle attacks against exact CDEF-rifle and player-unarmed defender profiles. Lightsaber ricochet remains separately blocked.

equation.precondition: authenticated Core3 primary result is HIT
equation.evadeSkill: min(defender level + secondary skill + private secondary skill, 125)
equation.success: attacker accuracy total + random(1..500) <= evadeTotal + random(1..200)

outcomes.block: attack remains successful; base and elemental damage are halved; defender result is block
outcomes.dodge: attack is unsuccessful and applies no damage; defender result is evade
outcomes.counter: attack is unsuccessful and applies no damage; defender enters combat and queues the legacy basic counterattack at front priority

fallbackPolicy.missingDefenderWeapon: complete NGE attacker and defender result path
fallbackPolicy.missingExactDefenderProfile: complete NGE attacker and defender result path when the authenticated primary roll hits
fallbackPolicy.unknownSecondaryResult: complete NGE attacker and defender result path
fallbackPolicy.primaryMiss: retain the authenticated Core3 miss without consulting a secondary profile
fallbackPolicy.reason: A Core3 primary hit must never be blended with the NGE defender table.

included: unarmed random block, dodge, or counter selection
Core3 roll ranges, cap, center-of-being, posture, and state suppression
legacy SWGSource basic counterattack command plumbing
deferred: non-CDEF and non-unarmed defender weapon profiles
live outcome telemetry and deterministic fixture rolls

buildEvidence.environment: isolated swg-precu Linux build volume with exact staged files

requiredBeforeReady: live status exposes defender profile, evade skill, center-of-being, posture, both rolls, and final outcome
a controlled block proves exactly half base and elemental damage before armor
a controlled dodge proves zero target-pool damage
a controlled counter proves zero incoming damage and one basic response command
missing-profile acceptance proves the complete NGE result path is restored
fixture cleanup restores defender weapon, skills, states, position, combat, and HAM
